parser: page.extract_text(visitor_text=visitor), full pages joined by one newline; check exact font alignment

formulas.characters_without_whitespace: sum(not c.isspace() for c in text)

comparison_policy.written: whole F010 / (whole U_R + whole R1), first comparison
comparison_policy.including_program: whole F010 / (whole U_R + whole R1 + whole CODE), separate complete-validation-inclusive comparison
comparison_policy.raw_program_alternative: whole F010 / (whole U_R + whole R1 + both complete raw validation programs), alternative representation
comparison_policy.conditional: whole F010 / whole R1 after acquiring whole U_R and both complete validation programs; the programs are validation, not proof premises

calibration: Every substitution binds the actual font dictionary, effective encoding, original PDF text event/byte, page, offset and context. Three decoded tabs are actual visible right braces; all other actual/generated whitespace is retained. Original printed mathematics is not corrected by calibration.
